rateLimits.note: Public pool, single-record requests (x-rate-limit-limit 5 / 1s, x-api-pool public-single). Polite pool (mailto parameter or agent header): 10 a second, concurrency 3. Plus (paid key): 150 a second, no concurrency limit.
Public pool, list requests (x-rate-limit-limit 1 / 1s, x-api-pool public-array). Polite pool: 3 a second, concurrency 3.

provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10: the access-and-authentication page's table (public 5 / concurrency 1, polite 10 / 3, Plus 150 / none; the interval is given by the x-rate-limit-interval header). Test calls the same day showed separate limits for single records and lists: public-single 5/1s, public-array 1/1s, polite-single 10/1s, polite-array 3/1s, concurrency 1 (public) or 3 (polite). The keyless public figures are declared; the polite pool needs a mailto parameter or an e-mail in the agent/User-Agent header. 429 = rate limited, 403 = blocked: back off.
